# judo-ui-react-template

> A Java-based code generator that transforms JUDO UI Models (EMF/XMI) into production-ready React/TypeScript frontend applications, part of the JUDO platform by BlackBelt Technology.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 multi-module project (4 modules + 6 integration test sub-modules)
- Handlebars templates + Java helper classes generate complete React 19 / TypeScript / MUI 7 / Vite apps
- Template registry (`ui-react.yaml`) maps templates to output files using Spring Expression Language (SpEL)
- Generated apps use Pandino (OSGi-style DI), Biome formatting, and i18n via JSON files
- Snapshot-based regression testing via `judo-diff-checker-maven-plugin`
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Modules — Core

- [judo-ui-react/pom.xml](judo-ui-react/pom.xml): Core generator module containing Handlebars templates (`src/main/resources/actor/`), the template registry (`ui-react.yaml`), and Java `@TemplateHelper` classes

## Modules — Testing

- [judo-diff-checker-maven-plugin/README.md](judo-diff-checker-maven-plugin/README.md): Maven plugin that compares generated files against committed snapshots for regression detection
- [judo-ui-react-itest/ActionGroupTest/pom.xml](judo-ui-react-itest/ActionGroupTest/pom.xml): Integration test for action groups (community MUI)
- [judo-ui-react-itest/ActionGroupTestPro/pom.xml](judo-ui-react-itest/ActionGroupTestPro/pom.xml): Integration test for action groups (pro MUI license)
- [judo-ui-react-itest/CRUDActionsTest/pom.xml](judo-ui-react-itest/CRUDActionsTest/pom.xml): Integration test for CRUD operations
- [judo-ui-react-itest/OperationParametersTest/pom.xml](judo-ui-react-itest/OperationParametersTest/pom.xml): Integration test for operation parameters
- [judo-ui-react-itest/RelationTest/pom.xml](judo-ui-react-itest/RelationTest/pom.xml): Integration test for relations
- [judo-ui-react-itest/SimpleOrderManagement/pom.xml](judo-ui-react-itest/SimpleOrderManagement/pom.xml): End-to-end order management scenario test
